title.note: Game title kept in English per glossary (brand); players search the English title.

hud.cast.note: Slovak angling verb for casting the line; infinitive, as Slovak buttons are.

hud.reel.note: Imperfective 'keep reeling in' fits a button held while the fish bites; same verb as the pass Autonavíjanie.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1, 2-4 and 5+ all read correctly.

catch.success.note: 'You caught' is carried by 'úlovok' (catch), avoiding gendered 'Chytil si'. {rarity} opens the sentence so its capital is right, and every rarity.* label must be masculine to agree with 'úlovok' (Vzácny, Legendárny, Mýtický). Sample: 'Vzácny úlovok: Zlatý kapor!'

catch.escaped.note: Generic 'ryba' since any species can escape; 'ušla' agrees with 'ryba', not the player. Single ellipsis character.

catch.new_record.note: Developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Slovak writes '12,4'. Format with a decimal comma for sk-sk.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Keeps the lantern idea (lampáš = lantern); invented name, so a native reviewer should confirm it sounds right. 'Svietiaci úhor' (glowing eel) is the fallback but loses the lantern.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine to agree with 'úlovok' in catch.success and with masculine fish names; Legendary should be 'Legendárny', Rare 'Vzácny'. Mythic above Legendary is the usual game ladder.

shop.rods.note: Fishing rods (rybárske prúty); the shop context makes the short plural clear.

shop.equip.note: 'Vybaviť' (equip) also means 'sort out' in everyday Slovak; 'Použiť' (use) is unambiguous and pairs with the label 'Používaš'.

shop.equipped.note: 'You're using it': state, present tense, no gendered participle; 'Používaný' would read as 'second-hand'.

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux kept invariant after the number per the locale guide; a native reviewer may prefer 'Robuxov' if no price is under 5.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel. 'Automatické navíjanie' (21) is more standard but over the 14 budget. The pass's Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Návnada šťastia ti zdvojnásobí šancu na vzácne ryby!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name built from the glossary words návnada + šťastie, like 'Elixír šťastia'; 'ti' renders 'your'. 'vzácne' = glossary Rare.

sell.all.note: 13/12: one over the estimated budget; no shorter natural wording keeps 'all' ('Predať ryby' drops it). Widen the button slightly or accept 'Predať ryby'.

sell.done.note: Two label forms, because 'Predal si {count} rýb za {coins} mincí' is gendered and breaks for 1 and 2-4.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern 'Otvor stlačením E' (imperative + instrumental), not 'pre predaj'. Developer: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText 'Predať' would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: Noun 'rise', the plain non-religious word (Czech 'vzestup'); a verb like 'vystúpiť' means climb or get off a bus. Same word in ascend.confirm.
ascend.button.blind_remark: a noun ("ascent, rise"), not a command; reads as a label rather than an action

ascend.confirm.text: Vzostup teraz? Začneš odznova, ale vzácne ryby budeš chytať o {bonus} % častejšie.
ascend.confirm.note: Future tense ('začneš', 'budeš chytať') avoids gendered past forms. 'o {bonus} % častejšie' = by that much more often; no-break space before %.

weather.storm.text: Blíži sa búrka! Vzácne ryby berú.
weather.storm.note: 'Ryby berú' is the Slovak angling idiom for fish biting.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon, since '{n} rýb' breaks for 1 and 2-4. Moonlit Bay translated per glossary and inflected (locative).
quest.catch_n.blind_remark: number after the colon; unclear whether {n} is the target or the progress so far

friends.boost.text: Rybačka s kamarátmi ti dáva +{percent} % šťastia
friends.boost.note: 'Rybačka' is the everyday word for going fishing; 'kamarát' avoids the boyfriend reading of 'priateľ'. No-break space before %.

trade.sent.note: Head noun 'hráčovi' carries the dative so the username is never declined; generic masculine as in the guide's 'Výmena s hráčom {player}'. 'Žiadosť o výmenu odoslaná hráčovi' is 34, over the 33 budget.

trade.accept.note: Present tense avoids gendered 'prijal/prijala', as the guide does for '{player} vstupuje do hry'. 'tvoju' is right here: the possessor is not the subject.
trade.accept.review_reason: Imperfective "prijíma" reads as still in progress (the back-translation came out "is accepting"); stative "súhlasí s výmenou" says the trade was accepted, stays gender-neutral and uses the glossary word výmena.

afk.kicked.text: Pre príliš dlhú nečinnosť sa rybačka zastavila.
afk.kicked.note: Restructured around the inactivity because 'Bol si príliš dlho nečinný' is gendered. No mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: Colon form: 'Končí o {time}' could read as a clock time. Developer: '2d 4h' should be '2 d. 4 h' for Slovak.

daily.streak.text: Séria: {day}. deň v rade! Vráť sa zajtra po ďalšie odmeny.
daily.streak.note: Ordinal '{day}.' works for every integer and avoids '{day} dní' plurals. 'for more' made explicit as 'po ďalšie odmeny' (for more rewards).

tip.night.text: Tip: niektoré ryby berú iba v noci.
tip.night.note: 'Tip:' is normal Slovak; 'berú' = biting, as in weather.storm.

group.join.text: Pridaj sa do skupiny a získaj 50 návnad zadarmo!
group.join.note: Bait counted as units, matching the HUD counter; '50 kusov návnady' is the alternative if 'návnad' sounds off to a native reviewer.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest catch': the board ranks by weight; 'Najväčší úlovok' could read as size.
